posts.author: Paltian
posts.body:
Hi! I'm Paltian, a videogame music composer (and also a lover for chiptune, pixel and retro things!).
I've just released a short puzzle-platform game called "TR3SS".
I've been using RPG Maker 2003 since it's first release in Europe. This game is the result of me trying to publish a little game before continue developing a RPG game I'm making with this software. (If you're curious, the other game is "
Haphazard: Sons Of Despair
).
Down below you have all the info of the game, and the link to play it on Itchio or Gamejolt. I hope you try it, and of course any feedback is more than welcome! Thanks.
Paltian.
------------------------------------
T R 3 S S (V 1.0)
Gamejolt
Itchio
​
#puzzle
#platform
#indie
#rpgmaker
#rpgmaker2003
#1bit
#retro
#chiptune
TR3SS is a small puzzle-platformer game where you must complete each level by jumping exactly 3 times—no more, no less! As you progress, you'll discover new mechanics... Will you be able to beat all the levels?
CONTENT:
40 levels divided into 4 zones.
An
original chiptune soundtrack
composed by video game music artist Paltian, in a pure retro style with the limitations of third-generation consoles.
An intriguing story that unfolds as you advance, changing based on your actions throughout the game.
Handcrafted 1-bit graphics, featuring up to 7 available colors.
A secret mini-game (Only if you achieve 100% completion!)
...and many secrets!
VERSION 1.0:
The game has been tested and is fully completed, but you may still encounter some bugs. If you do, please let me know in the comments so I can fix them in future updates. Thanks!
Developed in RPG Maker 2003 by Paltian. All game content (including story, images, sounds, and music) was handcrafted by Paltian, without the use of AI.
HOW TO INSTALL:
To install the game, download the compressed file, extract it, and click on the .exe file named 'Setup'. Follow the installation process, and once it's complete, use your computer's search function to find the application 'TR3SS'; select the executable file and... enjoy the game!
Special thanks to the KURWEZ Team for the betatesting!
Hope you enjoy it!

posts.author: Himex998
posts.body:
Helloo!!
I have played your game and finished 84% of it. First of all, I wanted to appreciate the simple yet genius mechanism of your game! Also the fact you made both art and soundtrack makes the game way better (for example I could never be able to make game soundtrack by my own, can only dream about it ToT), it's a huge talent to be able to make art, music and game itself! I think the game is perfectly balanced, however I've found two bugs I wanted to show there. First of all - there's a softlock at a few places (few places yet the same type of mechanism). Here's the screenshot:
As you can see, bridge is turned off yet you are able to jump, but after you try, game just softlocks itself and the only way to leave is alt+f4 (...or other ways, I guess.). It's not in the way of finishing the game, however I think it can become a bit annoying (especially if you forget to save before). Second bug (not actually the bug, but more like a typo:
The correct spelling there is ,,Ach
ie
vements"!
Moreover, I really enjoyed your game and I love how perfectly balanced it is! In some levels there are also a few ways to finish the level, which only makes the game better. Ignoring the softlock and typo I'd rate your game 10/10, there's literaly nothing I can complain about and I think you have a talent for game developement - good luck with your future projects!
Oh, and also - I have uploaded first (of 2)episode of your game on my youtube channel, but if you don't want it to be there then please let me know as soon as possible. That's all I have to say, good job with your project!

Hello Himex! Thank you so much for trying the game and for taking the time to post your impressions of it.
I really appreciate your kind words! I've been  a video game music composer for many years, and now I'm making little games like these on RPG Maker 2003 on my scarce free time!
About the bugs you mention and the typo; thanks for telling me! I'm going to fix both things on a future patch. I hope those softlocks weren't that annoying...
And I can't wait to see the videos! Please share it with and I will post them on my social media!!
Thanks!
